bridge: Anti-splash composite-packet library plus defect-packet influence-graph CA
novelty_signal: Strongest surviving CA bridge because it attacks the validated blocker directly: the current single-packet q/s basis is frozen and fake-local, so locality has to be restored by the actuator library and the graph the CA lives on.
validation_plan: Enumerate symmetry-safe 2-, 4-, and run-boundary composite packets on the canonical 64-modular seed.
Measure changed-lag support, upper-tail splash, and improving-or-neutral packet rates on the canonical seed and at least one solved control.
Retain only low-splash composites and build a sparse bipartite defect-packet graph from exact delta fingerprints.
Benchmark CA, greedy, tabu, and simulated annealing on the exact same retained library, budget, and seed.
Audit locality metrics and structured-family leakage before claiming a new CA branch.
risk: Composite packets may secretly encode known Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, or cocyclic structure.
If the packet scan or graph neighborhood widens toward whole-state behavior, the CA claim collapses back into local search with CA vocabulary.
A better packet library might help every baseline equally, which would weaken the CA-specific claim.

bridge: Lag-residue CA on four 167-channels with explicit family-leakage audit
novelty_signal: Promoted because the feedback says the lag field, not raw q/s adjacency, is the natural local object. This is the intended H2 pivot once H1 fails for principled locality reasons.
validation_plan: Implement one lag-space representation only and precompute exact delta tables from packet actions to lag residues.
Run one matched non-CA lag-space control and one warning-propagation control in the same coordinates.
Reject the branch if updates require whole-spectrum recomputation or if successful trajectories canonicalize to known structured families.
Keep exact reconstruction and exact-hit rate as the acceptance gate.
risk: The branch may reduce to another optimizer over Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, or block-circulant structure.
Lag-space locality may still be fake if every useful move depends on global residue information.
A cleaner state space does not guarantee better actuators.

bridge: Warning-propagation side fields feeding lag-space or influence-graph CA
novelty_signal: Promoted as a strong secondary bridge because LABS-style local fields match the observed autocorrelation bottleneck better than raw geometry, while still keeping CA as the actuator rather than the scorer.
validation_plan: Alternate short warning-propagation refreshes with CA sweeps on the lag graph or defect-packet graph.
Benchmark against plain warning propagation and plain CA with identical packet libraries and accounting.
Measure reversal rate, vote coherence, and exact-hit statistics rather than only residual reductions.
Ablate the field channels to verify that gains come from the CA-field interaction rather than feature engineering alone.
risk: The method can collapse into message passing plus a trivial postprocessor.
If the same fields help ordinary local search just as much, the CA contribution shrinks sharply.
Field computation may smuggle in global information.

novelty_signal: Still plausible only as a second-order mechanism. The latest validation shows schedule tuning alone cannot unfreeze the current single-packet basis.
validation_plan: Defer until a defensible low-splash packet library or lag-space representation exists.
Once locality is honest, measure burst size, burst duration, and post-burst exact-objective gain under matched budgets.
Compare directly against simulated annealing using the exact same action set.
risk: Easy drift into generic annealing or support diffusion without exact-objective improvement.
A local thermostat can be cosmetic if the real bottleneck is actuator quality.
Large bursts destroy the locality claim.

bridge: CA-scheduled local exact micro-solvers for isolated defect clusters
novelty_signal: Useful hybrid bridge if localized clusters emerge, but it is no longer a pure CA method and should be treated as a scheduler-plus-microsolver design.
validation_plan: Attach only after the influence graph or lag graph isolates genuinely local clusters.
Compare the same micro-solver under a CA scheduler and a non-CA scheduler.
Report solver-call counts, cluster size, and exact-hit contribution separately from the CA transport layer.
risk: The CA can become a thin wrapper around exact search.
Micro-solvers may only help because they re-enter known structured families.
Cluster extraction itself may require global scans.

novelty_signal: Interesting only after the representation issue is fixed. The latest feedback provides no reason to learn on top of the broken single-packet H1 state.
validation_plan: Choose a representation that already survives the locality audit.
Train on solved controls only and hold out entire order families or seed families.
Compare transfer against symbolic CA and non-CA baselines on the same channels.
risk: Memorization and poor transfer are the default failure mode.
Learned rules can hide family leakage or 668-specific overfitting.
A learned policy on a fake-local basis only buries the original defect.

bridge: Prime-field CA seed projection for the 167-core
novelty_signal: Still a bounded CA idea, but the newest validation says the current bottleneck is not lack of a seed family. It is the inability to move honestly and locally from the best known seed.
validation_plan: Benchmark projected F_167 CA seeds against random, m-sequence, and SAT warm starts.
Score only residual distributions and downstream repair compatibility at first.
Reject quickly if the seed tail is not materially better or if it collapses into known CA-construction families.
risk: Heavy prior-art overlap with CA-derived Hadamard-adjacent objects.
May optimize seed aesthetics without helping the real frontier bottleneck.
Could quietly encode known structured families under a new projection.

bridge: Current single-packet defect-syndrome CA on the q/s packet lattice
novelty_signal: The branch was useful as a falsification step, but the validation pack retired it as an active frontier method after the first matched kill test.
validation_plan: Do not widen the sweep.
Keep the implementation only as a negative control when testing new packet libraries or new state spaces.
Reuse its locality and diffusion diagnostics as the baseline failure signature.
risk: Frozen one- and two-packet neighborhood on the canonical seed.
Support diffusion above the seed on every frontier restart.
High risk of collapsing into rebranded local search because the basis is fake-local.

bridge: Generative spacetime row-emission CA rule search
novelty_signal: Conceptually ambitious, but the current validation moved it further away from the active frontier. The branch is still reserve-only and too exposed to direct CA-construction overlap.
validation_plan: No active budget now.
Revisit only after representation-changing repair branches fail for principled reasons.
If reopened, require reduced-control mimicry of the frontier defect profile before any order-668 claim.
risk: High prior-art overlap with existing CA construction work.
Likely mismatch between compact rule-table behavior and the irregular 167-core frontier.
Easy drift into brute-force rule sweeps that do not answer the order-668 bottleneck.
